headline: Approval of the 2027-2031 Library Strategic Plan, and an executive session on a personnel matter.
summary: Discussion and a vote on the strategic plan are on the agenda, along with an executive session. Reports from the Friends group, the foundation, and the director are also listed, as are budget feedback from city leadership and an update on the by-law review.
items: Public comments on topics not on the agenda
Additions and deletions to the agenda
Friends of the South Burlington Library report
Finance Committee: review budget feedback from city leadership
Governance and Nominations: update on by-law review
Discussion on the 2027-2031 Library Strategic Plan
Motion to approve the 2027-2031 Library Strategic Plan
Executive session to discuss a personnel matter
